info.title: ChinaExpress API
info.description: Stage 1 contract (quote, login, pre-notice, rate admin). Contract-first: hand-maintained until the backend exists, then the backend's `pnpm openapi` must regenerate this file unchanged (ADR 0003). Every amount in an example is what the backend pricing engine returns for that input; the frontend never computes it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID; safe retries. Required on warehouse, ops, finance and webhook writes (stage 2).

Money.description: Decimal amount as a string with two decimals. Never parsed into a JS number for arithmetic.

DecimalString.description: Non-negative decimal entered by the customer (cm, kg, m³).

label.description: Masked or display form, e.g. the email address

memberNo.description: Also the shipping mark printed on every carton

gstApplies.description: Show '+GST'; the GST amount itself is computed only on invoices

QuoteStatus.description: UNAVAILABLE = the product cannot carry this cargo (e.g. over the sea-parcel limit); REQUIRES_REVIEW = manual quote needed

copyText.description: Exact Chinese text the customer forwards to the supplier

payload.description: Rate card payload, structure per product (design 04)
